definitions.explanation: Items or systems installed in a building or place for a particular purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{設備|せつび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}して→充実する：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設備|せつび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{冷暖房|れいだんぼう}→冷暖房：28048_reidanbou⟧{設備|せつび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}っている→整う：03935_totonou⟧。
examples.english: The air conditioning and heating facilities are in place.

notes:
{設備|せつび} refers to equipment, facilities, or installations that are set up in a building or location for a specific purpose. Composed of {設|せつ} (set up) + {備|び} (equip, prepare).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {設備|せつび}⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧: capital investment (in equipment)
- {設備|せつび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to set up/prepare facilities
- {設備|せつび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}して→充実する：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: well-equipped
- ⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧{設備|せつび}: production equipment
- ⟦{冷暖房|れいだんぼう}→冷暖房：28048_reidanbou⟧{設備|せつび}: HVAC facilities
- ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}→消防：03241_shoubou⟧{設備|せつび}: fire-fighting equipment
- ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧{設備|せつび}: latest/state-of-the-art equipment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧: equipment, devices (individual items)
- ⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: facility, institution (the building/place itself)
